text: plink_prefix PLINK file prefix (extension). `.bed`, `.bim`, `.fam`, `.raw` file required. plink_path Path PLINK executable. ref_alt Optional `data.frame` columns `SNP, CHR, POS, REF, ALT`. harmonize_strand Correct REF/ALT reference genome. drop_ambiguous Drop /T C/G variants harmonization. gff3, cds, pep, genome_fasta Local reference file paths. left `NULL` fetched `reference_source`. reference_source One `"local"`, `"msu7"`, `"rapdb"`, `"ensembl"`. crop_species, crop_assembly Ensembl Plants species assembly. ensembl_release Ensembl Plants release. `NULL` queries current release. reference_cache Cache directory downloaded reference files. pheno_id_col ID column `phenotype_data`. on_fail One `"stop"` `"warn"` compatibility failure. qc_report_dir Directory input-QC report. skip_validation Skip compatibility ID-overlap checks. work_dir Directory intermediate files. gwas_snps GWAS hit table. Mutually exclusive `gene_list`. gene_list Character vector gene IDs. Direct-gene mode. phenotype_data Phenotype table ID trait column. trait_col Trait column name. Exactly one trait per run. trait_label Human-readable trait label figures. direction One `"higher"` `"lower"`. phenotype_type One `"single_env"`, `"blup"`, `"blue"`. pc_cols Principal-component columns. `NULL` skips correction. subpop_col Subpopulation column frequency summaries. posthoc Post-hoc tests three--haplotypes. n_perm, n_boot Permutation bootstrap iterations. min_cohens_d Minimum Cohen's d superior-haplotype gate. alpha Significance threshold. trait_threshold Absolute trait value required superior haplotype. use_all_transcripts Use transcripts canonical one. regions_to_include Functional regions haplotype construction. max_miss_snp, maf_min, max_het_ind, max_miss_ind QC thresholds. min_individuals_qc Minimum individuals QC. min_ind_per_hap Minimum individuals per haplotype group. min_hap_freq Minimum haplotype frequency. ld_decay_distance Optional LD-decay distance bp. ld_decay_file Path saved LD-decay RDS previous run. output_dir Output directory. save_only_superior Write per-gene files superior genes. keep_intergenic Keep LD regions overlapping gene. figure_formats Figure output formats. aa_full_names Use three-letter amino-acid codes. gwas_snp_col, gwas_pos_col, gwas_chr_col Column names `gwas_snps`. require_fdr `TRUE` (default) gene `Is_Superior` also passes BH-FDR (< `alpha`) across genes tested run. plot_style One `"gene_list"`, `"per_gene"`, `""`, `"none"`. plot_palette One [hbr_palette_names()]. plot_theme One [hbr_theme_names()]. plot_table_style `"color_coded"` `"row_highlight"`. plot_panels Panels draw. plot_width, plot_height Figure dimensions inches. plot_combined_pdf Write combined multi-page PDF. go_enrichment Run GO enrichment annotation. go_enrichment_source One `"msu7"` `"rapdb"`. go_enrichment_min_term, go_enrichment_min_superior Enrichment size gates. go_enrichment_cache Cache directory annotation downloads. save_breeding_rds Save `pipeline_result_for_breeding.rds`. rds_compress Compression RDS file(s). One `"fast"`, `"none"`, `"xz"`. rds_reference reference sequences saved: `"embedded"` (inside breeding RDS), `"separate"` (sibling `pipeline_reference.rds`), `"none"` (drop sequences). save_plot `FALSE`, figures written. store_all_results Retain every per-gene result. `TRUE` keeps full per-gene object every tested gene; memory grows linearly number genes. Prefer CSVs disk unless caller really needs every gene memory. verbose Print progress. `TRUE` prints one concise status line per pipeline phase per gene; `FALSE` prints nothing except errors warnings.

title: HaploBreedR 0.99.1
text: haplobreed_analysis(): single-trait pipeline GWAS hits gene list superior haplotype per candidate gene. Builds LD decay LD regions genotype, discovers functional variants (nonsynonymous CDS UTR) every tested gene, tests haplotype-trait associations (Student’s t-test / one-way ANOVA, optional PC correction, Tukey Duncan post-hoc), applies effect-size, permutation false-discovery gates. Supports local, MSU7, RAP-DB Ensembl Plants reference sources. hbr_generate_input_qc_report(): unified input-QC report covering sequence-resource quality, genotype-reference compatibility individual-ID overlap, written text report three CSV tables. hbr_check_inputs(): pre-flight validation PLINK files, phenotype records, GFF3 features sample-ID overlap launching full pipeline. hbr_go_enrichment(): GO -representation per aspect (BP, MF, CC) tested-gene universe, BH-FDR correction. hbr_regate(): re-applies superior-haplotype gates (alpha, effect size, optional FDR, optional trait threshold) directly stored summary table sensitivity analysis. hbr_read_results(): ingests completed per-trait output directory classed hbr_run object downstream visualisation genomic selection. hbr_gene_carriers(): extracts per-individual carrier status pipeline’s superior haplotype given gene, used colour prediction-quality panels. hbr_add_cross_annotation() (internal): MSU7 ↔︎ RAP-DB gene-ID mapping RAP-DB release table; GO attachment via org.Osativa.eg.db installed.

title: HaploBreedR 0.99.1
text: hbr_advanced_decision(): multi-trait parent ranking cross design one haplobreed_analysis() runs. Two-kernel genomic BLUP (VanRaden 2008; Kang et al. 2008) pipeline’s superior haplotypes feature kernel; honest nested cross-validation -fold discovery replay (M0 = GBLUP, M2 = features chosen data, M3 = features re-discovered inside training fold) paired comparison three (Nadeau Bengio 2003 corrected t-test plus paired bootstrap individuals). hbr_fit_models(): phenotype-dependent half pipeline (loading, GRM, haplotype codes, gate replay, cross-validation, final models, multi-trait index). Returns hgsi_fit object can saved reused. hbr_cross_design(): second half pipeline. Consumes hgsi_fit object, groups superior haplotypes haplotype blocks, computes cross usefulness (Schnell Utz 1975; Zhong Jannink 2007), pyramiding probabilities required population sizes (Sedcole 1977), selects diverse parent set block coverage relatedness ceiling. Cross ranking usefulness, block coverage, balanced mix; haplotype-pyramiding probabilities DH / RIL / F2 population sizing. Exported modular building blocks: hbr_build_grm(), hbr_reml_two_kernel(), hbr_cross_usefulness(), hbr_pyramid_probability(), hbr_population_size(), hbr_cross_plan(), hbr_trait_conflicts().

title: HaploBreedR 0.99.1
text: hbr_haplotype_blocks(): standalone block calling set target loci. Supports map-based rules ("recomb", "ld", "either"), SNP-level methods ("fourgamete", "gabriel") two combinations ("recomb+gabriel", "recomb+fourgamete"). Gabriel implemented Gabriel et al. (2002) D′ confidence interval vectorised pairwise gamete counting. hbr_haplotype_block_table(): block summary table per-locus assignment one call, users want block table without full pipeline.

title: HaploBreedR 0.99.1
text: hbr_rice_genetic_map(): Nagamura et al. (1997) rice RFLP linkage-map anchors (n ≈ 1,650 markers, total 1,510 cM) data frame chr, bp, cm. Interpolated run time onto physical positions PLINK .bim monotone cubic Hermite spline. hbr_rice_genetic_map_summary(): one-row summary bundled anchors.
